worldcombat.skill.leafblade.summary: Wield a leaf like a sword and step in for one heavy horizontal cut: it opens the main target and shaves one stage of its defence, while the blade wind grazes those nearby. Contact, single-target, the heaviest of the four, with a high critical chance. Two-handed form is heavier and shaves one more stage; one-handed form is quicker and cleaner.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.0: Wield a leaf like a sword and step in for one heavy cut
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.1: Open the main target and shave one stage of its defence
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.2: Let the blade wind graze foes standing nearby
The edge deals %1$s physical damage at a %2$s-block contact range.
The swing spans %1$s degrees; up to 2 other nearby foes each take %2$s of the blade wind.
The main target loses %1$s stage(s) of defence and the cut stirs about %2$s shards.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.twohand.on: Two-handed form: power ×1.2, swing span ×1.1 and one more defence stage, but +3 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery and +6 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.twohand.off: One-handed form (default): faster wind-up and 4 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.95 and a slightly narrower graze.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the edge rises to %2$s and defence is shaved by %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.preference.t: On: power ×1.2, swing span ×1.1 and one more shaved defence stage, at +3 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery and +6 cooldown — for settling a fight in one blow. Off (one-handed form, default): faster wind-up and 4 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.95 and a slightly narrower graze — for repeated cuts up close.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; leaf blade must be up close, so this stays smaller than the ranged moves.
On: when a foe drops below four tenths of its health this heavy cut is preferred, to finish it or force a window. Off: health is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary melee heavy hit.
world_combat.move.leafblade.text.miss: The leaf blade swings through air
